title: About | Northgate Logistics
description: The history, standards and leadership of Northgate Logistics.
heading: About Northgate
intro: An independent logistics business built on a simple principle: do what was agreed, when it was agreed, and report on it honestly.

image.alt: Exterior of the Northgate head office at Northgate Park, Harlow

milestones.text: Founded in Harlow with four vehicles and a single warehouse.
Opened the Midlands depot at Daventry to serve national retail customers.
Opened the North depot at Wakefield and introduced live tracking for all customers.

people.name: Helen Marsh
people.bio: Helen joined Northgate in 2003 and has led the business since 2014, overseeing its expansion to three depots.

people.name: David Okafor
people.bio: David is responsible for the fleet, depots and cold chain operation, and previously ran distribution for a national grocer.

people.name: Sarah Lindqvist
people.bio: Sarah leads finance and commercial contracts, and joined Northgate in 2017 from a major freight forwarder.
